obs.instruction: Read today's four swatches from the top of the dispatch cabinet at the far end of the entrance hall. Clean the two rooms on the card and the hall spill. Leave treatment powder in the other rooms untouched. Stage the carton on the selected room mat, then park it on the selected hall mat. Protect the runners and return the vacuum to its dock.
